children: may retest support at $101.13 per barrel, a break below which could open the way toward $97.22-$98.97.

The market has briefly pierced below a rising channel. A duplicated channel suggests a deep fall to $91.12. The fall follows a series of projection levels on the uptrend from $75 more closely than it does a set of retracement levels on the uptrend from $91.12.

Resistance is at $104.63, a break above which may lead to a gain into $106.79-$108.13 range. On the daily chart, the spinning top from the previous trading session is seen as a sign of temporary stabilization rather than a bullish reversal pattern.
The contract is likely to drop into the $92.19 to $95.97 range, as indicated by a rising channel. The current fall is considered to be the same degree as the one from $102.
